inspiration.observed_pattern: A MariaDB regression query applies NATURAL JOIN inside two derived relations and then combines those relations with NATURAL RIGHT JOIN, exercising shared-column propagation and right-side null extension.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored shipment inventory report. Two derived relations naturally match shipment and region keys before a NATURAL RIGHT JOIN retains a shipment present only in the state relation; the schema, rows, labels, and report purpose are new.

fixture_notes: Shipment 101 appears in both derived relations and combines its fragile label with ready state; shipment 103 appears only in the right derived relation and must retain its hold state with a NULL label. Shipment 102 exists only in the left derived relation and must not appear in the NATURAL RIGHT JOIN result.
determinism_notes: Shipment and region keys, labels, states, and derived projections are fixed. Both result reads are ordered by stable shipment and value columns, with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE inventory_shipments (shipment_id INT PRIMARY KEY, region_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, shipment_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE inventory_labels (shipment_id INT NOT NULL, region_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, label_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (shipment_id, region_code, label_code))
CREATE TABLE inventory_states (shipment_id INT NOT NULL, region_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, state_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (shipment_id, region_code, state_code))

steps.sql: SELECT right_side.shipment_id, right_side.region_code, left_side.label_code, right_side.state_code FROM (SELECT shipment_id, region_code, label_code FROM inventory_shipments NATURAL JOIN inventory_labels) AS left_side NATURAL RIGHT JOIN (SELECT shipment_id, region_code, state_code FROM inventory_shipments NATURAL JOIN inventory_states) AS right_side ORDER BY right_side.shipment_id, right_side.region_code, left_side.label_code, right_side.state_code
SELECT shipment_id, region_code, shipment_name FROM inventory_shipments ORDER BY shipment_id
